# Several things look wrong in a race recording

I recorded a short race (`recording.mp4`) and several things in it don't look the way they
normally do in this game.

Some of what a vehicle carries, or has carried, is drawn or hidden wrongly compared with that
vehicle (it can show through something that covers the vehicle, instead of being hidden with
it, and its effects can be off too), some shadows
don't fall or turn like the others in the clip, and the race view sometimes shows more of the
road behind the vehicle it follows than ahead of it. Which things, when, and what they should
look like instead can be seen in the recording: the same kind of thing is drawn correctly
elsewhere in the same clip.

Please fix all problems. Apart from these, the track layout and the vehicles' movement in
the recording are correct and should keep looking the way they do now.

## Attached visual evidence

The recording is at `/app/.harbor_assets/recording.mp4`.

Inspect the attached video before making changes. You can pull individual frames out of it with
`ffmpeg`.

steps.message:
I fixed all the problems I found in the recording. The code compiles and the existing unit tests pass. I couldn't run the game and record a new clip here, so I haven't seen the fixes on screen yet.

**Carried missile**
- **Angle:** it sat crosswise on the car because it was given the car's heading in degrees where radians were expected. It now lines up with the car (`bonus/Missile.java`).
- **Hidden with the car:** while carried, it was drawn at the top layer, so it showed on the bridge while the car was underneath. It's now drawn with the car, so the bridge covers both. It also takes the car's tint if the car falls into water. Once fired, it still flies above everything with its own shadow, and the target marker is unchanged.
- **Flame:** after firing, the rocket flame came out of the missile's side. It now comes out of the back.

**Shadows**
- **Not turning:** shadows drawn by the shared helper (crates, bonus boxes, mines, the missile) were given their angle in radians where degrees were expected. They stayed square under a turned crate; now they turn with it (`utils/BodyRegionDrawer.java`). I also made them use the drawer's scale setting, which nothing currently changes, so this has no visible effect yet.
- **Car shadow direction:** the car's shadow fell up-left while the building, fence, bridge and helicopter shadows all fall down-right. It now falls down-right too (`racer/VehicleRenderer.java`).

**Race camera** (`racescreen/RacerCameraUpdater.java`)
- **Showing more road behind:** the look-ahead was mirrored left-to-right. Heading up or down looked fine, but heading left or right the camera moved toward the road behind the car. It now always moves ahead of the car.
- **Camera speed cap:** the limit on how fast the camera can move was applied after the camera had already moved, so it did nothing. It now takes effect. The cap is high enough that I don't expect a visible difference.

I didn't touch the track layout or how vehicles move.
